candidate_workaround: Reject collided seeds, inspect their exact semantic neighbours, and replace them with mechanisms and practice domains absent from the 620-title chain.
failure_signature: The first ten-title seed collided with frozen food cold-chain, Gibbs phase-rule, and target-trial surfaces and exposed two additional close substantive neighbours.
recurrence_guard: Treat every plausible title as a hypothesis until both lexical and substantive neighbour audits pass against all frozen proposals.
rollback: Discard all collided seed titles, retain the audit receipt, and award no novelty credit.
scope_boundary: Bounded owner-scoped novelty recovery only; no proposal is frozen until the replacement audit passes.
title: Replace collided proposal seeds after full-chain neighbour review
trigger_preconditions: A candidate proposal batch has been compared with all 620 frozen titles.
